title: Water trucked in
text: In Red Mountain, locals truck in water to avoid the arsenic that decades of mining left in the ground and in their tap water. Soil testing has found as much as 10,000 milligrams of arsenic per kilogram in some parts of the community. In 2022, Red Mountain received a 1.5 million dollar grant to clean arsenic-laden sediment left by historic gold and silver mining at the Kelly mine complex.
